_comment: The daily capacity feed. Lands 04:00, revised 11:00. Agent hours are revised
DOWNWARD on 14% of days, which is why the intraday re-run (pipelines/intraday.py)
must be able to withdraw a queued treatment and record that it did.
This is a VALUE document (doc 08 §2 class 1) and changing it is free. It is
also the only artefact in the project that changes daily, which is why pool
supply is a param and pool identity is code.

relaxations._comment: Change scenario 6: capacity cut 30% for six weeks during a contact centre relocation. The coverage constraints must be RELAXED DELIBERATELY, with the relaxation recorded, rather than silently violated.
relaxations.rationale: Contact centre relocation; agent supply down 30%. Without an explicit relaxation the allocator would spend the whole reduced capacity on the floor and the value-ranked fill would be empty.
relaxations._note: A relaxation is NOT an overlay. It is a constraint parameter owned by Collections Operations, with its own approval, and it is recorded on every account it touches. Routing it through the overlay mechanism would put a fairness floor on the commercial approval path, which is precisely the confusion overlays/surfaces.py exists to prevent.
